notes: Section 4, 1935 edition, 1-bit photocopy; same frame as 1929 p08 and 1935 p08. Sides (rule 1): the thin rule inside the thick bar on all four sides; inner edge measured every 20 px where paper lies beside it (thin dark run 2-12 px inside the thick bar, within 3 px of a cubic along the side), local robust linear fits (+-120 px), outline ~1.8 px inside, points every ~120 px. The page is turned ~0.3 deg and the rules bow (top 392->422, left 264->245 end to end). Corners (rule 2): thin-arc inner edge measured along rays and fitted (circle plus quadratic in angle, residual 0.14-0.24 px); outline ~2.2 px inside it, points every ~30 px; at each arc end the outline follows the map-side face of the short connector joining the arc tail to the rule (TL x 489 / y 611, TR x 4857 / y 641, BR y 3797 / x 4838, BL x 468 / y 3767). Kind b: the left-column blocks (solid commercial and outlined) are fused to the left thin rule for most of its length; there the outline follows the rule's inner edge fitted from the streets either side, through the block ink (almost all the ink left under the outline). The solid block at x 305-340 by lot 1726 runs into the BL thin arc (kind b, part beyond the arc outside); hatching and lot lines touch the bottom rule in places. Remove (rule 4): (1) the CITY & COUNTY ... ZONE MAP 1935 title, legend and scale block (rectangle ~4 px outside its ink, open paper), (2) the compass rose with its three long arrows (8-point convex outline ~5 px outside the ink), (3) the SECTION 4 badge (octagon ~5 px outside the ring). 'Join Sec. 5' and 'Join Sec. 3' print outside the frame. Doubt: a pasted grey (stippled) patch covers the bottom rule and the bottom edge of the map at x ~3838-3990, y >= ~3982; no rule is visible there, so the outline is interpolated straight across it from the rule either side (it does not follow the patch). At BL the step at y 3767 sits where the rule, the arc tail and a solid block fuse.
